name: Tic
howTo:
Make sets and runs with ever-bigger hands. Wild cards change every round.

# Setup
- Round 1 deals 3 cards each, then 4, 5, ... One card starts the discard pile.
- Wild cards are the rank matching the number of cards dealt (3s in round 1, then 4s, and so on), shown by the W badge.

# Your turn
- Draw from the deck or take the top discard, then discard one.
- Build sets (3+ of a rank) and runs (3+ in a row, same suit); wilds fill any gap. Lay them down in your lay-down area.

# Going out
- When all your cards fit into sets and runs, lay them down and press Tic!. Everyone else gets one more turn, then the dealer presses End Round.

# Scoring
- Cards left in your hand count against you (wilds count 0). The round winner gets -15.
- Lowest total after 8 rounds wins.
